performance.title: Performance

rules.unguarded_rearm: Timer can pile up copies of itself

frame_capture.note_windows: Needs administrator access, which Windows asks you to allow.
frame_capture.note_linux: On Linux this reads a Vulkan layer that runs inside Deadlock. Install it below, then add the launch option to Deadlock in Steam.
frame_capture.note_macos: Frame capture is not available on macOS, or under Wine.

runs.save_failed: Couldn't save that run. Try again.
runs.delete_failed: Couldn't delete that run. Try again.

performance.same_addons: Both runs had the same mods on, so any difference comes from something else.

report.title: Deadlock+ frametime comparison
report.disclaimer: Differences under 3% count as a tie. Frame pacing varies between matches, so a difference is consistent with a mod being the cause, not proof of it.

layer.installed_hint: It only loads into games started with the launch option below.
layer.install_hint: Installs a small Vulkan layer into your home folder. It does nothing until you add the launch option.
layer.unavailable: This build of Deadlock+ does not include the layer, so it cannot be installed.
layer.steps: Steam, Deadlock, Properties, Launch options. Then start the game and press Start here.

frametimes.title: Frametimes
frametimes.blurb: Record a play session and see your real frame pacing, 1% lows and stutter spikes.

scripts.title: Mod scripts
scripts.blurb: Check installed mods for script patterns that can hurt performance.

compare.title: Compare
compare.blurb: Set two saved runs side by side, for example with a mod on and off.

compare.save_failed: Couldn't save the comparison. Check the log for details.
compare.intro: Compare two saved runs side by side. Play the same map for a similar length of time in both, once with a mod on and once with it off. Frame pacing varies between matches, so a difference is consistent with the mod being the cause, not proof of it.
compare.empty_hint: Record a run on the Frametimes tab and save it with a label. You need two to compare.
compare.legend: Green marks the better side. Differences under 3% count as a tie. Run A was {a} long, run B {b}.
compare.mixed: Mixed result: {a} measures favour A, {b} favour B.
compare.favours_a: Every measure that differs favours A.
compare.favours_b: Every measure that differs favours B.
compare.addons_differ: Mods that differ between the runs

frametimes.intro: Records how smoothly Deadlock draws frames. Start it, play, then stop to see the numbers. Run it with a mod on and again with it off to compare.
frametimes.background: Deadlock is in the background, not counting frames
frametimes.limit: Recording is full. Stop to see the results.
frametimes.graph_caption_one: Last {count} frame · top of graph {ms} ms
frametimes.graph_caption_other: Last {count} frames · top of graph {ms} ms
frametimes.no_frames: Deadlock is running, but Deadlock+ can't see its frames. Restart the game and try again.
frametimes.summary_one: {count} frame over {time}. A spike is a frame at least 33 ms long and 2.5 times the median.
frametimes.summary_other: {count} frames over {time}. A spike is a frame at least 33 ms long and 2.5 times the median.
frametimes.save_hint_one: Save this run to compare later. It records the {count} mod that is on now.
frametimes.save_hint_other: Save this run to compare later. It records the {count} mods that are on now.
frametimes.stop_failed: Couldn't finish the recording. Try again.

scripts.intro: Scans the scripts inside your installed Deadlock mods for patterns that can hurt frametimes, like timers that pile up. Nothing is changed or run.
scripts.disclaimer: This is a best-effort check on the script text. A finding is a hint to look closer, not proof that a mod slows your game. A clean result does not clear a mod either. Only comparing frametimes with the mod on and off shows the cause.
scripts.no_install: Couldn't find your Deadlock install, so there are no mods to scan.
scripts.progress_paused: Scan paused while Deadlock runs · {done} of {total}

findings.nulled_not_cancelled: This mod forgets a timer without stopping it. Each time {fn} runs again, another timer can start and keep running.
findings.unguarded_rearm: {fn} restarts its own timer and also runs on an event, without stopping the old timer first. Each event can add a timer that never stops.

demos.title: Replays
demos.subtitle: Match replays saved by Deadlock on this PC.
demos.no_folder: Couldn't find Deadlock's replays folder. Install Deadlock through Steam and watch or download a replay in game.
demos.reference_build: "Older build" compares each replay with the newest build found among your replays (build {build}).

complete.label: Ready
complete.hint: Matches the newest replay build found here.

partial.label: Partial
partial.hint: An unfinished download. It will not play.

outdated.label: Older build
outdated.hint: Recorded on an older game build. It may not play.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.hint: This replay couldn't be read. The file may be damaged.

row.not_in_api: not in the Deadlock API yet
row.pinned_hint: Pinned: delete and cleanup skip it. Click to unpin.
row.unpinned_hint: Pin: protect from delete and cleanup

delete.disabled: The {trash} is turned off for this drive, so replays can only be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
delete.too_large_one: This file is too large to move to the {trash}. It can only be deleted permanently, and that can't be undone.
delete.too_large_other: These files are too large to move to the {trash}. They can only be deleted permanently, and that can't be undone.
delete.too_large_room_one: This file is too large to move to the {trash} ({needed} needed, {free} free there). It can only be deleted permanently, and that can't be undone.
delete.too_large_room_other: These files are too large to move to the {trash} ({needed} needed, {free} free there). They can only be deleted permanently, and that can't be undone.
delete.description: Frees {size}. Replays aren't backed up in Steam Cloud.
delete.recycle_hint: You can restore it from there.
delete.permanent_hint: Frees the space now. Can't be undone.

cleanup.title: Clean up replays
cleanup.description: Pick what counts as clutter. Nothing is deleted until you review the list and confirm. Pinned replays are always skipped.
cleanup.save_failed: Couldn't save the cleanup rules. They were changed back.
cleanup.turn_on: Turn on a rule to see what it would remove.

toast.delete_none: Couldn't delete those replays. Try again.
toast.pin_failed: Couldn't pin that replay. Try again.
